extracted.intended_audience: developers, enterprises, authors and researchers looking for OCR / PDF-to-text / STEM document conversion tools
extracted.subtask_description: Converting PDFs and images (especially STEM content: math, chemistry, tables, handwriting) into searchable, exportable, machine-readable text and editable formats, via APIs and desktop/snipping tools. Focus is on accuracy, throughput, and format compatibility for research and enterprise workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Speed and accuracy of conversion
rubrics_metrics.description: Quickly and accurately convert PDFs and images to searchable, exportable, and machine readable text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes both conversion speed and fidelity; outputs should be searchable, exportable, and machine-readable for downstream use.

rubrics_metrics.name: STEM-specific OCR capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: The most accurate OCR technology with deep STEM functionality, including math, chemistry, handwriting, tables, foreign languages, and full PDF document conversion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quality measured by how well domain-specific content (equations, chemical notation, scientific tables, handwriting) is recognized and preserved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Math equation-to-LaTeX fidelity
rubrics_metrics.description: Return LaTeX code for equations (works passably on handwriting, and nearly flawlessly on pdf equations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to convert visual math content into correct LaTeX is highlighted (testimonials note high fidelity on PDF equations and usable results on handwriting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Table recognition and preservation
rubrics_metrics.description: Preserving tables (does the best job of preserving tables).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Table OCR quality and structural preservation when converting PDFs is an explicit differentiator; important for data extraction from scientific documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handwriting recognition quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Handwriting Recognition / Digital Ink support; works passably on handwriting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes digital ink and handwriting support; evaluation should consider how well handwritten math/chemistry is recognized compared to printed content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Output format compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Compatible with LaTeX, Markdown, MS Word, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ability to export into multiple authoring/editing formats (LaTeX, Markdown, Word, clipboard) for researcher workflows and downstream editing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capture ergonomics and workflow integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Snipping Tool: allows you to OCR content from your screen and copy math and chemistry to your clipboard with a single keyboard shortcut.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ease of capture (single shortcut), desktop app availability, and quick clipboard workflow for inserting recognized content into other apps are part of product evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scalability and throughput
rubrics_metrics.description: Accurately convert large PDF and image libraries into machine readable text files in hours, not months. We process millions of pages of unstructured PDFs and images per hour.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For enterprise/ML use, important metrics are pages-per-hour throughput, ability to handle large corpora, and conversion speed for bulk jobs (suitable for training/tuning models).

rubrics_metrics.name: Security and enterprise readiness
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enterprise customers require secure processing, quotes/enterprise support, and assurances around data handling/privacy when converting sensitive documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration and editing features
rubrics_metrics.description: Snip: Markdown and AI-powered collaborative editing environment for researchers with world-class image and PDF conversion tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond raw OCR, value is measured by collaborative editing, AI-powered assistance, and integration with Markdown-based research workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document exploration and search
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Features that enable searching, reading, and interacting with converted PDFs (searchability, reader UI) are part of the product's utility for researchers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Language support
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multilingual OCR capability; evaluation should consider which languages are supported and the quality of recognition across languages.
